title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
reason: Major acquisition of Ona (and potentially Promptfoo) to expand Codex's cloud capabilities, a significant strategic move for frontier AI infrastructure.

sources.summary: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments, enabling long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.
Accelerates Codex growth to power the next generation of Python developer tools
OpenAI is acquiring Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development.
OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training.

title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
reason: Disproving an 80-year-old mathematical conjecture is a frontier-shifting milestone for AI capabilities.

sources.summary: An OpenAI model solved the 80-year-old unit distance problem, disproving a major conjecture in discrete geometry and marking a milestone in AI-driven mathematics.
